desc: Prove strong connectivity ⇔ every cut x∈[1,2N-1] is crossed by a matched pair; derive prefix-max condition M_k > q_k and boundary forces S[0]='B', S[-1]='W' (else 0).
Derive the inclusion–exclusion chain recurrence over q-plateaus (blocks L_j,V_j), answer = sum_j e[j]*(N-L_j)!.
Implement the CDQ online convolution with naive/numpy-NTT/big-int-Kronecker branches and N<=8 brute force.
Confirm the 3 provided samples pass (BWBW→1, BWWBWBWB→0, sample3→240792).
Self-test harness: fast path vs N<=8 brute force over all valid strings; vs independent O(m^2) recurrence for random N∈[500,3000] with numpy on/off.
Performance-test the fast path at N=200000 on worst-case inputs (alternating, plateau-heavy, all-B-then-all-W, random); measure runtime/memory, tune SMALL and thresholds, verify samples still pass.
Finalize the shipped single stdin/stdout program after performance tuning.
